label: Compare
seo_title: RunMyCampus Compare — EU data protection lens
seo_description: Compare tenancy, GDPR-aligned controls, and operational depth when evaluating school platforms in the EU.
headline: Compare with GDPR and operator governance in mind.
subheadline: Evaluate subdomain tenancy, audit trails, and regional defaults—not only feature checklists.

segments.title: Controller vs processor clarity
segments.body: Your school remains in control of education records; the platform supports documented processing instructions.

segments.title: Data residency posture
segments.body: Align deployment and registry defaults to your EU/EEA hosting and transfer requirements.

segments.title: Operational traceability
segments.body: Support and provisioning actions stay attributable for audits and DPIA evidence.

faqs.question: When does this page show?
faqs.answer: When MARKETING_CONTENT_REGION is set to eu (or the host uses regional routing that sets it), this file overrides compare.json.
